# Lab 7.12: Orchestrate with Managed Service for Apache Airflow

## What We Are Going to Do
Create an Airflow environment and run a DAG that loads a file, transforms it in BigQuery and checks the result. This environment costs money every hour, so delete it at the end.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Create the environment.** Go to **Managed Service for Apache Airflow** (formerly Cloud Composer) **→ Create environment**. Choose the smallest size, region `us-central1`, name `lab-airflow`. Creation takes about 20 minutes.

2. **[CLI] Write the DAG.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">cat &gt; bq_lab_dag.py &lt;&lt;'EOF'
from datetime import datetime
from airflow import DAG
from airflow.providers.google.cloud.transfers.gcs_to_bigquery import GCSToBigQueryOperator
from airflow.providers.google.cloud.operators.bigquery import BigQueryInsertJobOperator, BigQueryCheckOperator

PROJECT = "YOUR_PROJECT"
BUCKET = f"{PROJECT}-bq-labs"

with DAG("bq_lab_pipeline", start_date=datetime(2026, 1, 1), schedule="@daily", catchup=False) as dag:
    load = GCSToBigQueryOperator(
        task_id="load_sales", bucket=BUCKET, source_objects=["incoming/*.csv"],
        destination_project_dataset_table=f"{PROJECT}.lab07.sales_airflow",
        source_format="CSV", skip_leading_rows=1, autodetect=True, write_disposition="WRITE_TRUNCATE")
    transform = BigQueryInsertJobOperator(
        task_id="city_totals",
        configuration={"query": {"query": f"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `{PROJECT}.lab07.city_totals` AS "
                                          f"SELECT city, SUM(amount) AS total FROM `{PROJECT}.lab07.sales_airflow` GROUP BY city",
                                 "useLegacySql": False}},
        location="US")
    check = BigQueryCheckOperator(
        task_id="check_not_empty", sql=f"SELECT COUNT(*) &gt; 0 FROM `{PROJECT}.lab07.city_totals`",
        use_legacy_sql=False, location="US")
    load &gt;&gt; transform &gt;&gt; check
EOF
sed -i "s/YOUR_PROJECT/$PROJECT_ID/" bq_lab_dag.py</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[CLI] Upload the DAG.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud composer environments storage dags import --environment=lab-airflow \
  --location=us-central1 --source=bq_lab_dag.py</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[Console] Run it.** Open the **Airflow UI** link, find `bq_lab_pipeline`, and click **Trigger DAG**. Watch the three tasks turn green.

5. **[SQL] Check the result.**

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| DAG | Load → transform → check |
| Operators | GCSToBigQuery, BigQueryInsertJob, BigQueryCheck |
| When to use | Cross-system workflows beyond BigQuery |
| Cost | Hourly environment charge, so delete it |
